thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-78912 triggered for tenant=brightline (Dedicated) — High 5xx rate + tail latency spike. Link: https://pd.example/PD-78912

pagerduty: ***PD-78912*** Brightline dedicated cluster — paged oncall (severity: high)

emily oncall: ack — Emily here, grabbing the pager. Which pool/shard is flapping?

incident-bot: Alert details: pool=brightline-reserved-1, region=us-east-1, 5xx_rate=12% (baseline 0.2%), p99_latency=6.8s (baseline 2.1s). Spike started ~10:42 UTC.

mike_sre: I can see matching metrics in infra: node-level GPU memory climbs, then nvml reports OOM/retries. Might be fragmentation rather than hard OOM. Pulling node logs now.

emily oncall: running quick check ->
```bash
kubectl -n dedicated get pods -l tenant=brightline -o wide
# OUTPUT (trimmed)
# brightline-infer-0   1/1 Running   0     3d    10.0.7.34   gpu-phi-07
# brightline-infer-1   1/1 Running   0     3d    10.0.7.35   gpu-phi-08
# brightline-infer-2   1/1 Running   0     3d    10.0.7.36   gpu-phi-09

kubectl -n dedicated logs brightline-infer-0 --tail=120 | tail -n 60
# shows repeated allocator failed/reschedule events and long stall at kv cache memcpy
```

ana_platform: (cc @ana_platform) we can spin up burst nodes from the reserved pool. Recommend +2 nodes in us-east-1 while we triage.

luis_csm: pinging Brightline SRE and CS lead to give heads up. ETA to customer update in ~5m.

emily oncall: I'm going to put brightline-reserved-1 into maintenance so we stop scheduling new requests to the problematic shard. Executing control-plane command.
```bash
# put shard in maintenance
curl -X POST "https://control.redwood.internal/api/v1/dedicated/shards/brightline-reserved-1/maintenance" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"reason":"investigating GPU mem fragmentation"}'
# response: {"status":"ok","drain_started":true}
```

jess_rotation: acked PD. If we need full restart, we should drain and restart inference daemon on affected node(s). Mike, are you able to restart node gpu-phi-07?

mike_sre: initiating restart of inference daemon on gpu-phi-07. tailing logs. If restart doesn't clear fragmentation we'll try process-level restart + driver bounce.

emily oncall: also prepare fallback routing to quantized smaller variant for Brightline so user-facing latency improves while we fix. Ana, can you apply route override?

ana_platform: applying route override now — enabling fallback model-variant=brightline-small-4q to serve heavy requests. Command:
```json
POST https://console.redwood.internal/api/v1/routing/overrides
{"tenant":"brightline","route":"/v1/generate","fallback_model":"brightline-small-4q","ttl_s":900}
```

incident-bot: PD update: escalated to Eng-Platform at 11:00 UTC due to cross-team mitigation.

mike_sre: restart completed on gpu-phi-07. Observed immediate drop in GPU fragmentation counters; inference daemon reattached to nvml cleanly.

emily oncall: metrics update: after drain+restart+fallback: p50 ~300ms (was 280ms), p99 ~850ms (down from 6.8s), 5xx rate -> 0.8%. Looks much healthier.

luis_csm: I told Brightline CS that we had a brief degraded window (~15m) and that we routed them to a quantized fallback to keep requests healthy. They asked for a postmortem.

mike_sre: root cause hypothesis: allocator fragmentation due to long-lived large KV cache + intermittent long sequences causing slab starvation. Will open follow-up ticket to add autoshrink + earlier KV evictions under high-alloc churn.

ana_platform: created PLAT-5623 referencing PD-78912 for allocator patch and an autoshrink config. Scheduling canary for Brightline to enable fallback earlier in the routing path as a precaution.

emily oncall: thumbs up. We'll keep PD open until metrics stable for two consecutive 5m windows. Anyone object to marking Resolved after that? :thumbsup:

jess_rotation: no objections. I'll take handoff for the postmortem and ensure runbook updates.

incident-bot: PD update: Incident PD-78912 resolved at 11:12 UTC — status: resolved, notes: drain+restart+fallback applied, metrics recovered.

emily oncall: closing thread here. Follow-ups: PLAT-5623 (alloc patch), ENG-IMPACT-451 (postmortem + customer comms). Thanks all. :heart:
